children: Adv provided clarifications on its August 25 direct listing, registered resale shares, largest shareholder holdings and CFO transition.
Announced that the August 25 direct listing was not an underwritten offering and the company received no proceeds.
Resale prospectus covers up to 94,046,357 existing shares held by registered stockholders; company gets no proceeds.
Confirmed largest shareholder Asamitsu Kosugi beneficially owns 232,638,232 shares (~47.76%) and sold or transferred no shares through Sept 9, 2026.
Stated none of Kosugi’s shares are pledged, hedged, lent or under a 10b5-1 trading plan as of Sept 9, 2026.
Noted CFO Katharyn Field resigned Aug 27; CEO Grady Ryther is interim CFO while a permanent successor is sought.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Adv Provides Clarification on Direct Listing, Largest Shareholder and Management Transition
